name: "Dachiriba!" ~Tomodachi & Sensei & Ribagay to~
original_name: 『ダチリバ！』～トモダチ＆センセイ＆リバゲイと～
source:
A completely ordinary gay student, our protagonist (Satou Satoru) is trying to pass the summer as usual.  But, interesting individuals start appearing around him just as various events start happening. Our protagonist is caught tight between love for his friend and his teacher, when...

The story will change based off your choices.  If the protagonist's name is changed, the other characters will refer to you differently in game.
translation:
我们的主人公佐藤悟是一名非常普通的男同性恋学生，正像往常一样打算度过暑假。然而，随着各种事件接连发生，有趣的人物开始出现在他身边。主人公在对朋友和老师的爱之间被紧紧夹住，就在这时……

故事会根据你的选择改变。如果更改主人公的名字，游戏中其他角色对你的称呼也会随之改变。
